The cataloging also encourages community interaction, as neighbors share stories and insights about the river’s changes over time. Together, we build a living record of the neighborhood’s natural heritage. As the river continues to shape the landscape, our efforts ensure that its legacy is preserved for future generations.  

P.P.S. Do not forget the volunteers.
